name: small_cli_change
title: Add a dry-run flag
body: Add a dry-run flag to a Go CLI command. The plan must identify parsing, execution, documentation, and tests without editing source.
acceptance: The command accepts --dry-run and performs no mutations when set.
Hermetic tests cover dry-run and normal execution.

name: medium_persistence_change
title: Record retry telemetry
body: Plan a change that records structured retry telemetry in SQLite and exposes it through an existing cost view. Preserve compatibility and avoid leaking secrets.
acceptance: Retry attempts and terminal failures are stored with duration and token counts.
The cost view renders the new records while preserving old rows.
Secret-shaped fields are rejected and covered by hermetic tests.
The migration is safe for existing databases.

name: workflow_guard
title: Prevent workflow work-ahead
body: Plan state-derived enforcement that permits source edits only in executor-owned workflow states. Named isolated performers must work during dispatch while the driving session remains denied.
acceptance: Edit-capable states are derived from workflow DOT rather than hardcoded names.
Backlog, plan, reviewer parks, terminal states, and in-flight driving sessions deny edits.
The exact dispatched performer may edit during its matching step.
Claude, Grok, and Codex mutation events have hermetic coverage.
Resolution failures deny closed with actionable recovery text.
